text: 其中，2027年食糖进口关税配额总量为194.5万吨，其中70%为国营贸易关税配额。2027年羊毛进口关税配额总量为28.7万吨，毛条进口关税配额总量为8万吨。（商务部网站）
text_en: Among them, the total 2027 sugar import tariff quota is 1.945 million tons, of which 70% is the state trading tariff quota. The total 2027 wool import tariff quota is 287,000 tons, and the total wool tops import tariff quota is 80,000 tons. (Ministry of Commerce website)
